content.transcript: Here's how often you should take oil of oregano, and if you don't believe me, I'm a pancreatic cancer researcher, so biology is my thing. Oregano oil is nature's strongest antimicrobial agent. It removes parasites, bacteria, fungi, viruses, everything. But here's what most people get wrong about dosing. A lot of people say you should take it two weeks off, two weeks on. And that's true if you're using cheap, weak brands. But when you're using real ultra-strength oregano with 85% Carvacrawl, your body handles it differently. The active ingredient in oregano oil is called Carvacrawl, and it has powerful effects on your immune system. Some people take it daily for months with no issues. Others prefer cycling. It really depends on what you're dealing with. You should always take oregano oil with black seed oil, because while oregano oil fights off the microbes, black seed oil gives your body antioxidant support and prevents any die-off reactions. I'm super picky about what I put in my body, so I only take the one from Resilia. It's simple, just two key ingredients, Carvacrawl from oregano oil and thymoquinone from black seed oil. They're third-party tested in the U.S., all-natural, non-GMO, and gluten-free. I personally take it every single day, half for two years. No breaks needed when it's quality. I'm dropping the link for you right here. They're 70% off for Black Friday because they believe everyone deserves access to real health solutions. Let me know if you tried oregano oil daily. I'd love to hear your experience in the comments below.
